verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching the core professional filing flow is the account login pages ('Connexion à l'espace professionnel', 'Connexion à mon espace Finances publiques'). Nothing documents a keyless or file-number entry path that starts filing without creating an account first. Items like simulators, buying a fiscal stamp, or paying public invoices are only listed by title, with no description of how you get in, and they are adjacent services rather than the core filing flow.
